title: Critical: Oxygen Level Dangerously Low (SpO2 88%)
description: Patient oxygen dropped to 88% (safe is above 90%). Heart rate spiked to 125 bpm.

context.suspectedRootCause: Probable airway compromise or mask slipping during bed movement.
context.recommendedAction: 1. Check patient breathing & alertness immediately. 2. Verify oxygen mask fit. 3. Adjust sitting posture upright.

title: Warning: Breathing Faster Than Normal (26/min)
description: Patient is taking 26 breaths/min (normal is 12-20). Oxygen is slightly low at 91%.

context.suspectedRootCause: Early shortness of breath or nebulizer/steam dose due.
context.recommendedAction: 1. Check if patient feels breathless. 2. Check if breathing medicine is due. 3. Re-check oxygen in 5 minutes.

title: Sensor Alert: Heart Monitor Sticker Loose
description: Chest sticker came slightly loose when patient moved in bed. Heart vitals are actually normal (64 bpm).

context.suspectedRootCause: Electrode adhesive slipped off skin during patient turning.
context.recommendedAction: 1. Re-stick chest sensor during next routine nursing round. 2. Audio buzzer silenced so patient can sleep.
